entries.scope: Recursive composition and span-scoped SmallViT studies. Separate from the baseline first-two-block direct comparison; no universal interface or full-model Transformer claim.
Explicitly managed application arenas and runtime prototypes are not total-process RAM, physical MCU execution or general GPU/energy results.
Imported Residual-CNN C59/C60 and unresolved original C61. C61R+ is a different Residual-MLP line; it does not recover the original experiment.

Low-shift relative non-inferiority, target-validity limits, calibration and pipeline controls. Read each protocol; not every suffix denotes confirmation. Non-inferiority failure is not automatically established inferiority.
Unpivoted QR prefixes are order-dependent under the documented rank assumptions. This is established linear algebra and a construction diagnostic, not a new theorem or a classification advantage.
Basis/geometry exploration. Head9 was sufficient in this cohort, not proven minimal; head8 and residual-SVD8 also passed. Learned-fit error remains despite an ideal output-preserving projection.

Head-derived9 versus P64: accuracy difference -0.231482pp (95% -0.787038 to +0.347221), hidden NMSE ratio1.139064 (1.119058 to1.159426), protocol PASS. Candidate-to-teacher -5pp absolute safeguard NOT established in this cohort. Fixed digits split, sigma0.36, N384,4096 final parameters; no whole-model or measured communication compression.

N384 and N512 head9 passed absolute safeguards in this cohort; N512 head9 accuracy gain +0.324075pp (95% -0.162036 to +0.810186) was not established. Does not rewrite C76R uncertainty or prove a sample minimum.
Stronger-teacher regression work remains separate. Target quality and external validity are not accepted as a headline by this preview.
